coverage_notes: Executed 12 targeted web searches covering sole/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-canceled food distributions, pantry/food-bank service interruption, and official SNAP/WIC/EBT access interruption.
No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified within the bounded observation window.

Fresh results were either stale, routine program or promotion material, non-U.S., or did not establish an immediate qualifying food-access loss; examples included routine WIC scheduling and non-qualifying retail closures.
Production collection remains authoritative; this supplementary recall watch did not approve, publish, alter the schedule, or disable the task.
